name: Marinated Beef Curry
description: 500g • Medium Spice. Vacuum-sealed tender beef curry chunks marinated with authentic Bengali spices.

cookingSteps.title: Heat Mustard Oil
cookingSteps.instruction: Add 2-3 tbsp mustard oil into wok.

cookingSteps.title: Simmer & Roast
cookingSteps.instruction: Cook on low flame for 15-20 minutes until tender gravy forms.

name: Classic Chicken Biryani Mix
description: 800g • Serves 3-4. Pre-measured fragrant kalizira rice, marinated chicken pieces, and spice blend.

cookingSteps.title: Boil Rice
cookingSteps.instruction: Half boil rice with whole spices.

cookingSteps.title: Dum Cooking
cookingSteps.instruction: Layer rice over chicken and dum cook for 15 mins.

name: Hand-stretched Frozen Paratha
description: 10 Pieces. Hand-stretched flaky layers, clean hygienic dough ready to toast on tawa.

cookingSteps.title: Heat Tawa
cookingSteps.instruction: Place paratha directly on medium-hot pan without defrosting.

cookingSteps.title: Flip & Toast
cookingSteps.instruction: Flip after 30s until both sides turn golden flaky brown.

name: Spicy Vegetable Samosas
description: 12 Pieces • Ready to Fry. Golden crisp triangular pastry filled with spiced potato and peas.

cookingSteps.title: Deep Fry
cookingSteps.instruction: Fry in hot oil at 170°C for 6-8 minutes until golden crisp.

name: Smokey Beef Seekh Kebab Kit
description: 6 Skewers • Pre-spiced tender minced beef kebabs ready for pan grilling or oven bake.

cookingSteps.title: Pan Fry or Sear
cookingSteps.instruction: Brush with butter/oil and grill on medium heat for 10-12 mins.

name: Mustard Marinated Hilsa Fish (Shorshe Ilish)
description: 4 Large Cut Steaks • Fresh Padma Ilish marinated in pungent yellow mustard and green chilies.

cookingSteps.title: Steam or Simmer
cookingSteps.instruction: Simmer in mustard gravy on medium heat for 15 minutes.

name: Bhuna Meat Curry Gravy Base
description: 300g Packet • Concentrated roasted onion, ginger-garlic & secret whole spice bhuna paste.

cookingSteps.title: Add Meat or Veggies
cookingSteps.instruction: Sauté with your choice of protein and half cup hot water.

name: Shahi Tukda Dessert Kit
description: Serves 4 • Ghee fried bread slices with condensed rabri milk & crushed pistachios.

cookingSteps.title: Pour Rabri
cookingSteps.instruction: Pour chilled rabri over fried bread and garnish with pistachios.
